Mulch & Soil Calculator

Work out how many cubic yards or bags of mulch, soil or gravel you need for any bed or area.

–
Cubic yards
–
2 cu ft bags
–
Cubic feet

Volume = L × W × (depth ÷ 12) ft³ ÷ 27. Bag count is rounded up.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the bed length and width in feet.
  2. Enter the depth in inches (3 is standard for mulch).
  3. Read the cubic yards needed and the equivalent bag count.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How deep should mulch be?

2-4 inches is standard for weed control and moisture. Topsoil for planting beds is usually 4-6 inches deep.

How many 2 cu ft bags make a cubic yard?

13.5 bags. A cubic yard is 27 cubic feet, so 27 ÷ 2 = 13.5.

Does the material type change the math?

No. Cubic yards measure volume, which is the same for mulch, soil, sand or gravel. Only the weight differs.
